remarks: This Stunning Townhouse/Condo nestled in Private Pinegrove Cul-De-Sac features a welcoming foyer, which opens to a Dramatic Great Room with Soaring Vaulted Ceilings.  Highlighted with Gas Fireplace and Skylight, Accented with Gorgeous Hardwood Flooring and Built-ins.  The Classic Kitchen Showcases Custom Cabinetry with Soft Closings, Rich Granite Countertops, Equipped with SS Appliances, Dining Area with Sliding Door to Spacious Wooden Deck Overlooking Lush Greens and Views of 8th hole on Cloverbank Country Club [Formerly Known as Brierwood CC].  The Powder Room and Laundry are Conveniently Located on the First Floor.  On the Second Floor, the Spacious Primary Suite is Currently Used as an In-Home Office.  Additional Second Bedroom Completes the floor with Spacious Full Bathroom with a Whirlpool tub.  Attached Two Car Garage.  Partially Finished Full Basement Offers an Additional Space for Entertaining or could be used asa Play Room/Gym and Storage Area.  For Easy Living and Lifestyle, HOA Covers Grounds Maintenance for Lawn and Snow Removal, Master Insurance, Water/Sewer, Common Area.  Sorry, NO Pet Policy.  Owner Reserves the Right to Set the Offer Due Date.  Don’t Miss The Opportunity to Own This Beautiful Townhome!  Also listed as a single family: B1719166.
